text: The 2021, 2022, and 2023 tree-cover loss events on the property are all supported by the evidence. The 2021 loss (81.3 ha) and 2023 loss (4.5 ha) meet the corroboration rule, as the JRC 2020 reference agrees on ≥50% of the event area (98% and 100%, respectively). The 2022 loss (0.6 ha), while small, also meets the fraction threshold (94%) and is above the 0.5 ha minimum event size. No contradicting evidence is present for these events. The 2020 baseline shows 92.6% of the asset as forest, consistent with the loss events occurring afterward. Smaller patches of loss (<0.5 ha) are excluded per the methodology.
